spec: Implement `pay`: authorize the purchase (user must be a known customer), check the amount against the per-transaction rate limit, then charge via the payment gateway. The authorizer rejects unknown users with Err("unauthorized"); the rate limiter rejects amounts above its limit with Err("rate exceeded"); the gateway charges purchases up to its internal per-transaction limit and declines larger ones with Err("declined"). A successful payment is Ok(()).

externs.name: auth_check
rate_limit
stripe_charge

extern_dafny:
datatype Result<T, E> = Ok(value: T) | Err(error: E)

method {:extern}{:axiom} auth_check(user_id: int) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires user_id > 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (user_id < 1000)

method {:extern}{:axiom} rate_limit(amount: int) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires amount > 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (amount <= 5000)

method {:extern}{:axiom} stripe_charge(amount: int, token: string) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires amount > 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (amount <= 100)
